text.text: IBM FlashSystem A9000 provides the performance, integration, and economics that you require in a cloud-optimized storage solution. This powerful, 8U modular system integrates the extreme performance of IBM FlashCore ® technology, highly parallel architecture and comprehensive data reduction in one powerful solution.

text.text: IBM MicroLatency modules are fundamental to IBM FlashCore ® technology. By using IBM-designed, purpose-engineered flash storage modules, FlashSystem delivers extreme performance, greater density, and mission-critical reliability - check out this white paper to learn more about our patented RAID scheme, a key capability within our FlashCore technology.

text.text: Inside FlashSystem A9000, you'll find 3 grid controllers and 1 flash enclosure powering microsecond latency, up to 300+ TB of effective capacity, and hundreds of thousands of IOPS.

text.text: Though it's shown with only 4 here, you can manage 100s of IBM FlashSystem A9000 systems from a single pane of glass with IBM Hyper-Scale Manager.

text.text: Each flash enclosure includes two fully redundant interface canisters that distribute data across all of the flash modules. This is the first key to our 2D RAID approach (the other key being IBM Variable Stripe RAID ® ). With non-blocking crossbar backplanes, low latency direct memory access, concurrent code load, and non-disruptive maintenance, these canisters are built with high availability at their core.

text.text: IBM FlashSystem® A9000 is a highly parallel all-flash solution for the cloud-scale business: Harness the performance of highly parallel architecture and IBM FlashCore ® technology in one innovative system Optimize storage economics with pattern removal, deduplication and compression Prevent \\u0022noisy neighbor\\u0022 problems with quality of service (QoS) features that support multi-tenancy and mixed workloads Deliver consistent, extreme performance to meet service level agreements for unpredictable, data-intensive workloads Easily integrate with VMware, OpenStack, and Microsoft platforms, and with almost any existing infrastructure Simplify storage administration with an innovative, new user interface

graphic.text:
IBM FlashSystem® A9000 is a highly parallel all-flash solution for the cloud-scale business:

Harness the performance of highly parallel architecture and IBM FlashCore® technology in one innovative system
Optimize storage economics with pattern removal, deduplication and compression
Prevent \\u0022noisy neighbor\\u0022 problems with quality of service (QoS) features that support multi-tenancy and mixed workloads
Deliver consistent, extreme performance to meet service level agreements for unpredictable, data-intensive workloads
Easily integrate with VMware, OpenStack, and Microsoft platforms, and with almost any existing infrastructure
Simplify storage administration with an innovative, new user interface

text.text: Whether you are a service provider requiring highly efficient management or an enterprise implementing cloud on a budget, IBM FlashSystem ® A9000 provides qualities you need for a solution that is simply consistent, simply reliable, simply efficient: Fast: IBM FlashCore ® technology delivers consistent microsecond latency, even with full-time data reduction. Efficient: Flash-optimized data reduction, like pattern removal, deduplication and compression lower TCO, while thin provisioning and snapshots maximize storage efficiency. Consolidated: This modular offering includes QoS and supports multi-tenancy so that you can consolidate diverse workloads, applications, and users under one roof. Feature-rich: Integrated data services - like sync/async replication and IBM Hyper-Scale Manager - provide enterprise-class data management capabilities. Secure: With features like multi-dimensional RAID and encryption, FlashSystem A9000 keeps your data safe and secure.
